rules.heading: EFFECTS OF THE AHUTI IN THE MOUTH OF PLANETS IN HAVANA

planetary.freeform: Sun receives Ahuti: destruction of auspicious effects; Moon receives Ahuti: crops inundated; Mars receives Ahuti: fear of fire; Mercury receives Ahuti: increase in intellectual powers; Jupiter receives Ahuti: fulfilment of desired objective; Venus receives Ahuti: profit of worldly and otherworldly property or wealth; Saturn receives Ahuti: destruction of wealth and loss of kingdom; Rahu receives Ahuti: loss of every kind; Ketu receives Ahuti: famine, death and loss of kingdom.

rules.notes: Describes the auspicious and inauspicious results depending on which planet receives the Ahuti during a Havana or Yajna.

rules.heading: THE ABODE OF LIVING OF FIRE IN THE HAVANA AND THE AUSPICIOUS AND INAUSPICIOUS EFFECTS OF IT

planetary.freeform: (Tithi + 1 + weekday number) divided by 4. Remainder 3 or 0: Fire is on Earth (auspicious/happiness); Remainder 1: Fire is in Heaven (loss of life); Remainder 2: Fire is in Paatal/Underworld (loss of wealth).

rules.notes: Calculates the elemental placement of fire for a Havana based on the desired tithi and weekday, determining happiness, loss of life, or loss of wealth.
